recipes.title: Hot Honey Freezer Protein Mini Pizzas (14)

items.i: seasoned chicken sausage, cooked and crumbled

steps: Mix the two flours with the Greek yogurt and knead into a smooth dough.
Divide into 14 balls and roll each out thin.
Cook the bases on a hot griddle or pan for a minute or two per side until set with light brown spots.
Lay on a baking sheet and add about 1 tbsp sauce, the mozzarella, turkey pepperoni and chicken sausage.
Bake at about 425°F for 8–10 minutes until the cheese melts and bubbles.
Mix honey and Buffalo sauce for hot honey and drizzle. Cool, wrap and freeze; reheat in the air fryer or oven.
recipes.notes: Dough amounts (420 g flour, half Fit Flour, and 420 g nonfat Greek yogurt) are from the video; he says each pizza is about 235 cal and 25 g protein. The caption only says to comment for the full recipe, so topping amounts, oven temperature, carbs and fat are my estimates.
